newsitem.title: USA: US cash crudes firm slightly heading into weekend.
newsitem.headline: US cash crudes firm slightly heading into weekend.

text.p: Prices for U.S. domestic cash crude grades and outright benchmarks strengthened slightly on Thursday, but volumes thinned considerably ahead of the extended Easter weekend.
May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing advanced around 5 cents to talk late at $20.65-75 a barrel. Paper market prices were largely bored by outside events, moving in small ranges.

Nigerian tensions seemed to recede after Shell announced that all of its employees that were being held hostage in a tribal dispute were released. Unrest in Nigeria has forced crude output cuts of 210,000 barrels per day, or 10 percent.
